department: Neuroscience Center Zurich (ZNZ PhD Program in Neuroscience, part of LSZGS)

deadline.value: The central graduate-school route is closed until further notice; you apply directly to ZNZ group leaders.
deadline.quote: You can contact ZNZ group leaders directly to enquire about PhD openings and apply to the group of your choice (Track II).

also.quote: Until further notice we do not recruit PhD students via the Life Science Zurich Graduate School online application portal (Track 1).

supervisor.value: Registration starts only after you and a supervisor agree on a project and the supervisor provides a position.
supervisor.quote: If the candidate and the future supervisor have both agreed on the PhD research project and a position is provided by the supervisor, the registration process can be started.

funding.value: The supervisor provides the position and handles the employment contract.
funding.quote: your supervisor’s group will deal with your employment contract

entry_route.value: Students typically hold a Master's degree in biology, psychology, physics, computer science and other fields.
entry_route.quote: Our students come from a variety of backgrounds with master degrees in biology, medicine, psychology, pharmacology, biochemistry, physics, chemistry, mathematics, engineering, computer science and other disciplines.

gre_subject.value: Not stated on the pages checked

notes: ZNZ is a program of the Life Science Zurich Graduate School.
